report:
Breast, right, wide local excision

The specimen consists of a right wide local excision specimen (32 g, 55 x 40 x 25 mm). Sectioning reveals a firm, grey-white, ill-defined, stellate tumour measuring 9 mm in greatest dimension (9 x 8 x 7 mm) in the upper outer quadrant (10 o'clock), 4 mm from the superior margin. The remaining breast tissue is fibrofatty and unremarkable. Three lymph nodes are identified in the sentinel node specimen.

(1-4) tumour with the superior margin.
(5-9) anterior, posterior, inferior, medial and lateral margins.
(10-11) remaining breast.
(12-13) sentinel lymph nodes (3 nodes).

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision (less than total mastectomy)
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour site: Upper outer quadrant (10 o'clock)
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 9 mm (9 x 8 x 7 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (ductal)
- Tumour focality: Single focus of invasive carcinoma
- Histologic grade: Grade 1 (scores of 3, 4, or 5); total score 4
- Tubule formation: Score 2
- Nuclear pleomorphism: Score 1
- Mitotic rate: Score 1
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an invasive carcinoma of no special type, Nottingham grade 1 (tubule formation 2, nuclear pleomorphism 1, mitotic count 1; total 4), measuring 9 mm in greatest dimension. The tumour infiltrates as well-formed tubules and glands lined by cells with uniform nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli, within a fibrous stroma. Ductal carcinoma in situ of low nuclear grade, cribriform type, without necrosis, is present (6 mm). There is no lymphovascular invasion.
- Tumour extension: Confined to the breast parenchyma
  - Nipple: Not present in specimen
  - Skin: Not present in specimen
  - Skin satellite foci: Not identified
  - Skeletal muscle: Not present in specimen
- Lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Dermal lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not applicable (no skin present)
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Breast treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Ductal carcinoma in situ: Present, Negative for extensive intraductal
  component (EIC)
  - Size (extent) of DCIS: 6 mm
  - Number of blocks with DCIS: 2 of 13 blocks examined
  - Nuclear grade: Grade I (low)
  - Necrosis: Not identified
  - Architectural patterns: Cribriform
- Additional lesions: Not identified
- Microcalcifications: Present in DCIS

Ancillary studies
- Oestrogen receptor: Positive
  - Intensity: Strong (3)
  - Positive nuclei(%): >2/3 (5)
- Progesterone receptor: Positive
  - Intensity: Moderate (2)
  - Positive nuclei(%): 1/3-2/3 (4)
- HER2/neu oncoprotein IHC: Negative for over-expression
  - Score: Faint / barely perceptible incomplete membrane staining in >10% of
    the invasive tumour cells (Score 1+)
- Proliferation index Ki67 (%): 10
- Cold ischaemia time: 45 min
  - Optimal (<= 60 min).
- Fixation time in buffered formalin: 24 hours
  - Optimal fixation (6-72 hours).
- Meet requirements specified in the latest version of the ASCO/CAP guidelines.
- Test type: Laboratory-developed test (QMH, HK).
- Formalin-fixed paraffin embedded sections were assessed by IHC technique for
  ER and PR, using Novocastra ER (clone: 6F11) and Dako PR (clone: PgR636) with
  the Bond polymer refined detection system.
- Formalin-fixed paraffin embedded sections were assessed by IHC technique for
  HER2, using Ventana monoclonal HER2/neu (4B5) with Ventana BenchMark ULTRA
  multimer detection system.
- Invasive breast cancers that test 'HER2-negative' (IHC 0, 1+ or 2+/ISH
  not-amplified) are more specifically considered 'HER2-negative for protein
  overexpression/gene amplification' since non-overexpressed levels of the HER2
  protein may be present in these cases.
- Patients with breast cancers that are HER2 IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/ISH not-amplified
  may be eligible for a treatment that targets non-amplified/non-overexpressed
  levels of HER2 expression for cytotoxic drug delivery (IHC 0 results do not
  result in eligibility currently).

Margins (invasive carcinoma)
- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: 6 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: 5 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: 4 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm

Margins (DCIS)
- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: 5 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: 4 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: 1 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm

Regional lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: Sentinel node biopsy only
- Number of lymph nodes examined: 3 (sentinel)
- Number of lymph nodes with tumour: 0

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b pN0(sn)
  - Stage group (if cM0): IA

Additional findings
- None

BREAST, right, wide local excision
- INVASIVE CARCINOMA OF NO SPECIAL TYPE, grade 1, 9 mm; DCIS present (low grade,
  6 mm); margins clear (closest: invasive carcinoma 4 mm, superior; DCIS 1 mm,
  superior); see synoptic report
- 0 of 3 sentinel lymph nodes involved
- pT1b pN0(sn) (AJCC 8th edition), stage IA (if cM0)
